# Kindred

> Home of the Kindred family app suite. The former relationship library is now Kenspeckle.

## Documentation

- [App suite and migration](https://github.com/forgesworn/kindred/blob/main/README.md): Suite links and the repository move for the relationship library.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/kindred): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [kenspeckle](https://github.com/forgesworn/kenspeckle): Use the renamed verified-relationships library.
